title: Friends Come And Go, But Life Moves On
content:
I have a message for anyone who has lost friends, and i know it's r/thanksimcured material, but i still want to put it out there

Friends will come and go, it's unavoidable. But instead of not making friends to protect yourself from the hurt of losing them, remember the good times. Times when you guys laughed together, cared for each other, and had a fun time. Don't dwell on it, though, as that could reset any progress you've made towards moving on. Also remember that it's possible they will come back, so things could go mostly back to normal.

As I said in "Just a random post" from 4/30/22, you deserve to be happy, and you should enjoy your life.

Don't be sad that it's over, be happy that it happened, and look forwards toward the future where you could meet even better friends and have even better experiences.
Also never forget that someone out there cares for you 💛
